question.problem:
Consider the matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & -3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].$
Which of the following statements are true?

I. $A$ is upper triangular

II. $A$ is lower triangular

III. ${A}^{T}$ is lower triangular
question.worked_solution:
Let's analyze each statement in turn.

- Statement I is false, since $A$ has non-zero entries below the main diagonal:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & -3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

- Statement II is false, since $A$ has non-zero entries above the main diagonal:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & -3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

- Statement III is false, since ${A}^{T}$ has non-zero entries above the main diagonal:

$$
{A}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ -3 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "None".
